description: This file defines the VoicemailImpl class, an immutable data object implementing the Voicemail interface for managing voicemail data within an Android application. It includes fields for voicemail attributes and nested builder class for construction.

classes.name: VoicemailImpl
classes.description: A final class representing an immutable voicemail data object, implementing the Voicemail interface with provided getter methods and a nested Builder class for flexible instance creation.

classes.name: VoicemailImpl.Builder
classes.description: A builder pattern class for constructing instances of VoicemailImpl with optional parameters, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: createForInsertion
methods.description: Creates a builder for a new Voicemail to be inserted, requiring timestamp and number.

methods.name: createForUpdate
methods.description: Creates a builder for updating an existing Voicemail, requiring the id.

methods.name: createEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new empty builder for creating Voicemail instances.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a VoicemailImpl instance from the set parameters in the builder.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the voicemail, or -1 if not set.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Checks if the id is set.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the voicemail number.

methods.name: hasNumber
methods.description: Checks if the number is set.

methods.name: getTimestampMillis
methods.description: Returns the timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: hasTimestampMillis
methods.description: Checks if the timestamp is set.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of voicemail in milliseconds.

methods.name: hasDuration
methods.description: Checks if the duration is set.

methods.name: getSourcePackage
methods.description: Returns the source package name.

methods.name: hasSourcePackage
methods.description: Checks if the source package is set.

methods.name: getSourceData
methods.description: Returns the source data string.

methods.name: hasSourceData
methods.description: Checks if the source data is set.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI associated with the voicemail.

methods.name: hasUri
methods.description: Checks if the URI is set.

methods.name: isRead
methods.description: Indicates if the voicemail has been read.

methods.name: hasRead
methods.description: Checks if read status has been set.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Indicates if the voicemail has content.
